info.name: ACMS API tests
info.description:
ACMS (Agricultural Cooperative Management System) API tests.
Set passwords in a Postman ENVIRONMENT (type: secret), never in this collection. Since the common-response refactor every answer is {success, message, data | error, timestamp}: the tests read data, and fall back to the top level for errors and message-only answers.
